1. What are cookies?
Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit piedramar.es. They help us remember your preferences, improve your experience, and understand how the site is used.

2. What cookies do we use?

Necessary cookies
These cookies are necessary for the website to function correctly. They cannot be deactivated. They are used, for example, to remember your shopping cart and complete payments.

Functional cookies
These cookies remember your preferences, such as selected language and login details, so you do not have to enter them again on your next visit.

Analytical cookies
We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use piedramar.es. These cookies collect anonymous data about, for example, which pages are visited and for how long. No personal data is stored.

Marketing cookies
We use Meta Pixel to show relevant ads on Facebook and Instagram to visitors who have shown interest in our products. These cookies track your behavior across different websites to make the ads more relevant to you.

3. Third-party cookies
We use the following third parties that may place cookies on your device:

Google Analytics — traffic analysis
Meta (Facebook/Instagram) — advertising and retargeting
Shopify — technical operation and payment solution

These third parties have their own privacy policies that we recommend you read.

4. How long are cookies stored?

Session cookies — deleted when you close your browser.
Persistent cookies — saved on your device for up to 24 months depending on the type.

5. How do you manage your cookies?
You can withdraw your consent or change your cookie preferences at any time through the cookie banner on piedramar.es.

You can also delete or block cookies directly in your browser. Note that this may affect the functionality of the website.

Guide for the most commonly used browsers:

Chrome — Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies
Safari — Preferences → Privacy
Firefox — Settings → Privacy and security

6. Consent
When you visit piedramar.es for the first time, a cookie banner appears where you can accept or reject non-necessary cookies. Your choice is saved and can be changed at any time.

7. Contact
If you have any questions about our use of cookies, do not hesitate to write to me.
